_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to change the Units page. Each unit is one block between { }. name, image (path in images/units/), intro (what the unit is about), duties (list). leader = {name, title, photo, phone, whatsapp, email, bio}. Only 3 units have an assistant block; to give a unit an assistant, copy the assistant block from one that has it. To remove an assistant, delete the whole assistant block (and the comma before it). whatsapp = digits only with country code, e.g. 2348012345678. Missing pictures show initials instead. Each line must end with a comma except the last one in a block.
